none.$description: No shadow. Single drop-shadow with zero geometry and a transparent colour, so it renders nothing. Flat, non-elevated surfaces and resting interactive states.

sm.$description: Small elevation shadow. Single drop-shadow. Surfaces that sit just above the page, such as cards and raised panels.

md.$description: Medium elevation shadow. Single drop-shadow. Surfaces lifted on interaction or layered over content, such as hovered controls and dropdowns.

lg.$description: Large elevation shadow. Single drop-shadow. Surfaces that float above the whole page, such as dialogs and modals.
